theme: New York by day, home to Florida by night.
greeting: Morning, Dan. The day is open until an afternoon neurology appointment with Mike at HSS, then an evening flight home to St. Pete — where your stay at the Heart of Kenwood begins tonight.

needsAttention.title: Book the last Croatia night in Cavtat
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 19 room still isn't booked — a night in Cavtat near Dubrovnik airport, after the charter disembarks and before the 7:30 AM flight out. It was due yesterday.

schedule.title: Neurology — Dr. Erin Manning
schedule.detail: With Mike at HSS Belaire; arrive by 1:45.

schedule.title: Flight home (DL 2433)
schedule.detail: LaGuardia to Florida, landing about 9:50 PM.

recipe.title: Olive oil-poached zucchini & raw tomatoes
recipe.why: Zucchini and tomatoes are at their late-August peak, and a slow olive-oil poach lets that summer produce carry a warm evening with almost no effort.

tasks.title: Confirm the Croatia sailing gear all lands before Sept 3

acts.line: An open morning in the city — nothing fixed until early afternoon.
An afternoon at HSS with Mike for the neurology appointment.
An evening flight out of LaGuardia carries you home to St. Pete.
